paragraphs.text:
The creature makes a shallow dive and blasts Bernard with the 
full force of its weapon before gliding away.

You rush to Bernard, where he lies on the ground. His eyes 
are wide and caked with ice.

Gain  1  point  of  Cthulhu  Mythos.  Make  a  Hard  CON  roll  for 
Bernard: if he succeeds, go to 636; if he fails, go to 635.
